method: Fresh Chrome contexts; real Bun server; saved dark theme on light OS; 1280x900; remote profiles use 100 ms emulated latency, 10 Mbps download, 4 Mbps upload and 4x CPU slowdown. Cold browser, not a rebooted server. Visible CDP browser with screencast/DOM/network sampling; shared host. Readiness is visible last paragraph for rich docs, visible text for Markdown, and visible frame heading plus hidden outer loading status for HTML. Preview readiness is sampled with requestAnimationFrame. Ready includes Playwright polling overhead.

phases.verified: Earlier optimized build, before browser-router workspace prefetch and HTML DOM-ready signal.
phases.release: Final behavior before unrelated overview formatting cleanup; shared-host contention was substantially higher than in verified samples.
phases.paired: Interleaved unchanged HEAD baseline (651d3da) and final optimized build, both rebuilt and served by their respective real Bun servers. Three samples per version and scenario, alternating order; shared-host variation still applies.
